name: BizPartner, investičné družstvo
decision_note: Investment cooperative founded in March 2026 at the BizPartner Group address in Poprad; registered for lending and property rental, a real-estate financing vehicle.

evidence.quote: Prenájom nehnuteľností spojený s poskytovaním iných než základných služieb spojených s prenájmom
For over 19 years, we have been combining finance and real estate at home and abroad.

analyst_notes: Seat Dlhé hony 5031/6, Poprad - same as BizPartner Investments, j. s. a. Bank of Spain list classes it as a real-estate fund. No RÚZ statement yet (registered 20.03.2026).
